policy_loading: plan reads this JSON; stores complete policy_contract and policy_source path/SHA256; apply revalidates the same policy version

selector.prompt_owner: separate candidate-selector prompt; never overwrite Flora prompt

input_versioning.relative_path_base: freeze to new sibling filenames in each original directory; do not rewrite receipt paths or source record fields
input_versioning.immutable_batch: one draft/plan binds a frozen batch; ongoing downloads/window preparation continue on their original files
input_versioning.change_action: new source bytes, task policy or prompt produce a new version; never ignore hash mismatches

atomizer.local_seconds_to_frame: ceil(seconds*30-1e-6); reject invalid bounds, never ask a model for timestamps
atomizer.context_event_bounds: clip to the parent; retain raw unmodified interval in provenance
atomizer.active_definition: eligible raw label core_owned_interval covers the complete atom
atomizer.eligible_label: complete final caption with valid source binding and nonempty instruction; unknown/mistake/incomplete and invalid-source labels are excluded

candidates.candidate_id_scope: task-local C000/C001/...; compare IDs only within their task
candidates.caption_equivalence: whitespace-only normalization: ' '.join(text.split()); exact case-sensitive equality; no synonym rewrite
candidates.neighbor_order: temporal distance then stable raw-label ID
candidates.context_only_labels: retained as neighbor candidates and raw provenance; never become extra simultaneous native rows

routing.window_seam: REQUEST_SELECTOR with reason_codes including WINDOW_SEAM; never assume mechanical core coverage validates semantic continuity
routing.invalid_source_binding: SOURCE_REPAIR_QUEUE; do not repair video identity by choosing a label
routing.fixed_folding_order: FORBIDDEN; respreading, recovery and repeated attempts are valid goals

window_seam.boundary_source: internal boundaries between window cores in the same parent
window_seam.context_conflict_trigger: within boundary +/-150 frames, valid raw parent_intervals from different windows fully cover the atom with different normalized captions; selector required even if only one is core-active
window_seam.adjacent_goal_trigger: atom directly touches a core boundary and the two sides have different valid core-owned normalized captions
window_seam.same_caption: rule resolution and adjacent merge remain allowed
window_seam.scope_note: plan.seam_scope must distinguish mechanical frame coverage from semantically validated window seams

evidence.source: actual parent video paths, SHA256, offset_s and parent_frame_zero_source_index
evidence.sampling: atom first/middle/last parent frame plus30 frames before/after, clipped to parent
evidence.rule_route: raw-label/source receipts are sufficient; no fictional VLM call receipt
evidence.selector_route: bind consumed evidence IDs and actual image file hashes; apply rehashes them

selector_io.selected_id: one offered candidate_id or literal UNKNOWN
selector_io.generation_constraint: token Trie restricts output to the offered ID strings plus UNKNOWN; wrapper emits JSON and program derives caption/bounds
selector_io.manifest_hash: SHA256 of exact input plan file bytes
selector_io.receipt: path+SHA256; binds selector identity, task hash, source video hashes, selected_id and actual evidence images
selector_io.cache_reuse: only same task_sha256, selector model/revision, implementation/prompt and evidence hashes; rebind envelope to current plan bytes
selector_io.invalid_response: record retry/UNKNOWN; never parse a free caption or use nearest valid ID as a silent fallback

auxiliary_actions.storage: sidecar only; retain all raw concurrent labels and their source IDs
auxiliary_actions.native_language_effect: none; exactly one primary instruction active per atom
auxiliary_actions.context_dependent_roles: hold/smooth can be the primary goal when evidence makes them the current task; no global keyword ban

merge.equivalence: same selected whitespace-normalized caption; task-local C000 IDs alone are not a cross-atom key

RULE_SINGLE_ACTIVE.meaning: one eligible active caption; rule accepted, not independently verified semantic accuracy

RULE_DUPLICATE_CAPTION.meaning: equivalent active captions grouped deterministically; all raw references retained

VLM_SELECTED_CANDIDATE.meaning: constrained candidate choice with source/evidence/identity receipts

LOCALLY_REPAIRED.meaning: local reannotation registered new candidate provenance and a new versioned selection decision

UNKNOWN.meaning: local evidence or label repair pending; cannot be emitted as an instruction

SOURCE_REPAIR_PENDING.meaning: missing/incomplete/incorrectly bound source assets; selector cannot certify source identity

unknown_repair.scope: only unresolved atoms with bounded neighbor context; unrelated resolved episodes continue
unknown_repair.first: expand local evidence/context and rerun constrained selector with a newly hashed task
unknown_repair.second: local caption reannotation as a separate stage; register a new candidate/source receipt, then rerun selector; selector itself still cannot invent caption/boundary
unknown_repair.remaining: small explicit exception queue for agent visual review or stronger model; no default user approval step
never: delete UNKNOWN and carry previous text forward
cut an episode into annotation atoms for training
mark entire dataset ready because temporal coverage is100%

unknown_anchor_fallback.threshold_basis: initial engineering routing thresholds; not a paper result or calibrated semantic accuracy guarantee
unknown_anchor_fallback.eligible_unknown_reason: explicit hash-bound selector UNKNOWN only; missing decisions and hard source issues do not qualify
unknown_anchor_fallback.normal_anchor_rows: retain the full known persistent timeline; clear both language columns only at explicitly recorded UNKNOWN anchor frames
unknown_anchor_fallback.native_effect: task-only low_level action supervision with no subtask text targets; flow and enabled FAST action loss remain native
unknown_anchor_fallback.materialization_audit: scan every row of actual derived v3 parquet; verify empty columns exactly at recorded UNKNOWN anchors, normal timelines elsewhere, and unchanged raw state/action/timestamp identity

native_adapter.interval_status: APPROVED is a machine-generated semantic-resolution result, not human/user approval
native_adapter.issue_resolutions: program writes rule/selector/repair decisions and receipt references for every source issue
native_adapter.timestamps: actual complete parquet timestamp column with source SHA256; never synthesize frame/30 as if read from data

rows.timestamp: actual timestamp at interval start frame

native_adapter.unresolved_parent: strict-parent remains pending; explicit small-gap fallback may retain the parent under unknown_anchor_fallback bounds, using native per-row empty-column task fallback rather than a new loss mask
native_adapter.partial_release: explicit included/pending parent lists and corresponding hashed subset artifacts; retain full original plan/draft references

automatic_counters: atoms and hours by quality grade
monitoring.semantic_audit: stratified automatic visual monitoring across duration strata and rule/selector grades; set runtime budget after measurement
monitoring.interpretation: unique complete frame coverage is a program invariant, not a measured semantic accuracy score
